set.presentation: A 78-year-old man who had surgery for numb hands on both sides 6 years ago now has 8 months of breathlessness, leg swelling and lightheadedness on standing; his BP pills were stopped as his pressure fell. BP 98/62 lying, 80/54 standing; JVP 12 cm; soft S3, no murmur.
set.workup: ECG: low QRS voltage in limb leads though echo shows a 17-mm septum and 16-mm posterior wall; EF 50%, big atria, stiff filling. Pyrophosphate scan: intense heart uptake; free light chains normal. Biopsy: Congo red-positive, birefringent deposits.
